versions.changelog:
audio-video 0.1.4

- Updated references to the features list: SKILL.md now explicitly points users to features.md for a concise overview of skill capabilities and example use-cases.
- No changes to core functionality or commands; documentation clarity improved for discovering supported features.

audio-video v0.1.3

- Expanded the skill’s supported triggers to cover advanced and repair workflows, including stabilization, 360/VR, HDR/tone mapping, multi-destination streaming, rolling DVR, VFR/CFR fixes, and more.
- Added a [features.md](./assets/features.md) file listing supported feature areas, organized by section.
- Updated documentation to reference the new features list, making it easier to see all capabilities at a glance.
- No breaking changes to existing command workflows.

Version 0.1.2

- Added documentation and reference assets: platform presets, quality checklist, codecs/containers, ffmpeg flags, and ffprobe analysis.
- Expanded support resources for codec compatibility and command flag guidelines.
- No changes to core processing logic or command rules.

No user-facing changes in this version.

- No file or documentation changes detected from the previous release.
- Functionality and usage remain identical.

audio-video 0.1.0 — Initial release

- Provides expert audio and video processing guidance using ffmpeg and ffprobe.
- Covers conversion, compression, editing, analysis, streaming, and processing of audio/video files.
- Includes platform-specific installation instructions and safety checks for required tools.
- Supplies ready-to-use command templates for transcoding, remuxing, extraction, and more.
- Enforces best practices: probing inputs, safe command construction, and validation steps.
- Supports macOS, Linux, Windows, and Docker environments.
